model: Parse paint URL/fallback separately from whole-value effect URLs. Resolve explicit fallbacks against completed resource headers before inheritance, recording, font selection or lowering. Preserve the original declaration when a server is available. Never catch rendering, cancellation or admission errors as fallback.

behaviors.fill: Available gradient, missing color/none/currentColor, wrong-kind target, empty gradient, quoted URL and functional alpha.
behaviors.pattern: Zero/missing dimensions, no element content and hidden resource use fallback. An empty group or hidden drawing child is available but transparent. A drawable tile ignores fallback.
behaviors.stroke: Available user-space gradient with round caps retains its gradient.
behaviors.lexical: Adjacent color functions, quoted closing parenthesis and a once-decoded escaped closing parenthesis.
behaviors.strictBoundaries: Missing targets without explicit fallback, external URLs, invalid colors, unsupported resource syntax and effect/marker fallback tails still reject.

tests.failingBefore: Eight original fill/stroke/inheritance cases failed on the baseline. All four admitted fixtures also reject with the frozen baseline library on each host.
tests.timingScope: Functional validation under concurrent local execution, including test-runner startup; not quiet-VM performance measurements. Final mechanism, rendering and original replay share the same NET11 production assembly.

originalReplay.qualification: Every original hash rechecked. Prior rendered PNGs are byte-identical; other outcome categories and comparisons remain unchanged. Fresh native triples use the same inspected 300x150 logical viewport and reproduce the existing target. No hosted payload retention or whole-corpus reference admission.
